themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, make decisions, and interact with systems or users.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content detailing AI's ability to condense large amounts of information, such as research findings, interviews, or data, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code, or assist in software engineering workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Tools and platforms that leverage AI to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Discussions and comparisons of different AI tools, benchmarks, and methods for assessing their performance and capabilities.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: The application of AI to analyze user feedback, reviews, and online conversations to understand sentiment and opinions.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: AI applications that directly assist in the creative and analytical processes of design and user research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and analysis on how AI is affecting jobs, skills, employment, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Studies and articles specifically about the capabilities, limitations, and impact of AI chatbots in various contexts.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: The creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for testing, simulation, or research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
